title: Script - Flag Reveal & ESP Hub
features:
NoobBacon Scripts is a feature-rich utility hub designed specifically for Guess My Football Country 🏆. This script eliminates guessing by automatically revealing opponent flags while providing full player tracking, camera tools, character physics modifications, and performance optimizations.

Key Features:

- Flag Reveal Utility: Instantly identifies and reveals hidden opponent country flags to guarantee wins.

- Visuals & ESP Suite: Includes Player ESP/Chams, directional Tracers, X-Ray wall removal, and Fullbright map lighting.

- Camera Modifications: Freecam for full map reconnaissance, unlimited zoom distance, and customizable FOV sliders.

- Character Physics: WalkSpeed and JumpPower adjustment sliders, Noclip, client-side Invisibility, BTools, and Ctrl + Click Teleport.

- Cosmetics & Trolls: Toggleable Rainbow Body, Headless avatar modification, Spinbot, Kill Aura, Earthquake screen shaking, and Sound Spam triggers.

- Server & Utility Tools: Direct Join by JobId, Server Hopper, Instant Rejoin, FPS Booster, and Anti-AFK protection.


Script Information & Transparency:

- Key System: None (100% Keyless, zero friction)

- Execution Requirements: Compatible with standard Roblox executors

- Keybinds & Controls: Managed directly through the native on-screen GUI menu


Instructions:

1. Copy the script code from the Script tab below.
2. Launch Roblox and join Guess My Football Country 🏆.
3. Open your executor, paste the copied code, and click Execute.
4. Use the on-screen menu to toggle your desired features.
